name: MessageLogger
description: Temporarily logs deleted and edited messages.
summary: Keeps deleted and edited messages visible for the session

settings.label: Inline edits
settings.description: Whether to display edit history as part of message content

settings.label: Ignore bots
settings.description: Whether to ignore messages by bots

settings.label: Ignore yourself
settings.description: Whether to ignore messages by yourself

settings.label: Ignore your edits
settings.description: Whether to ignore edits by yourself

settings.label: Ignored users
settings.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to ignore

settings.label: Ignored channels
settings.description: Comma-separated list of channel IDs to ignore

settings.label: Ignored servers
settings.description: Comma-separated list of guild IDs to ignore

settings.label: Show edit diffs
settings.description: Show visual differences between edited message versions

settings.label: Separated diffs
settings.description: Separate addition and removals in diffs for a more readable differential

notes: Logs live in memory (at most 5000 messages) and go away on restart or when the plugin is disabled, like upstream. IDs in the ignore lists are matched exactly (upstream does a substring test). The edit history window opens from the message context menu ("View Edit History") instead of by clicking "(edited)".
gaps: Collapsing deleted messages into a "N deleted messages" group (collapseDeleted) needs message grouping UI Qord does not have yet
Attachments removed by an edit are not kept (logDeletedAttachments); deleted messages keep theirs
